owner_authorization: Autonomous SEO/repair/commit/push for all existing French pages; verification for owner-only unknowns last; no new article loop

FACTS.acceptance: Owner NAP/hours/reference prices consistent in page, links and built output; unsupported deposits/passport/refunds/delivery/fleet claims removed or qualified; claim-level source and affected sections logged. Unknown owner-only facts deferred narrowly to final appendix.

INTENT.acceptance: Review actual French query/intent against closest sibling URLs. Record primary intent, owner URL for keyword group, supporting variations, parent hub and distinction from similar pages. Existing H1 is only a seed, not measured demand. Home owns broad commercial query; rental pillar covers process and choices.

CONTENT.acceptance: Read full page; repair repeated filler, SEO-process copy, weak French and missing answers using topic-specific useful material. Appropriate depth by role, no padding. Sources for changing/legal/model facts. No fabricated first-hand experience. Record sections changed and source URLs/date.

META.acceptance: Unique truthful title/meta/H1, coherent OG/Twitter, no English boilerplate; natural French terms and compelling factual benefit. Length is a heuristic, not hard Google limit. Reconcile legacy foundation matrices/QA when changing locked metadata. Canonical unchanged.

LINKS.acceptance: Useful source-body links to parent and relevant siblings/supporting pages; add contextual incoming links from relevant hubs/articles. Repair broken targets/fragments, confirm breadcrumbs/menu/footer and no accidental orphans in built HTML. No arbitrary maximum or exact-match spam.

AEO_GEO.acceptance: Answer real page question directly where useful, explain relevant entities/conditions and cite primary evidence for unstable claims; natural French FAQs/checklists/tables only if helpful. No repeated Q&A padding, made-up citations, AI inclusion promises or mandatory AI text files.

SCHEMA.acceptance: Inspect built JSON-LD, parse successfully, match visible facts. Correct WebSite/Organization or LocalBusiness/page/Article/Breadcrumb/Image relationships and stable @ids. Real dates/authors only; no fake rating/review/Offer/sameAs. FAQ is optional and not a promised Google rich result.

IMAGES.acceptance: Retain existing valid primary image and optional extra; verify actual bytes, responsive width/height, French pixel-accurate alt and OG/Twitter match, no broken paths. Visual relevance/duplication review. Record Figma upgrade separately; unavailable tools do not block the other page dimensions.

UX_CRO.acceptance: Check rendered mobile and desktop reading/layout, anchors/TOC, keyboard/contrast, contact options and confirmed hours/address. Appropriate contextual CTA with correct tel/Zalo/WhatsApp; no obstructive popup, fictional urgency or false service promise.

TECHNICAL.acceptance: Self canonical on intended production route, lang fr, indexability and sitemap consistent, useful page not accidentally noindexed/robots-blocked, shared build renders important content, no broken local assets/links. Preserve four legacy redirects. Distinguish local audit from actual HTTP/indexing.

LIVE_VERIFY.acceptance: After verified publish, test actual URL/primary asset/CTA and deployed built revision when reachable. Log URL/status/date and deployment run/SHA. Actual GSC indexing/rank/CWV not inferred from 200 or deploy; missing external access is BLOCKED_TOOL or owner appendix for that evidence alone.
